correctness.rationale: The explicit fourteen-arc model has 2186 nonempty faces by exhaustive dual enumerations and 132 facets. Matching 1091 face pairs is acyclic on every one of 10192 Hasse incidences. Its four critical cells are in dimensions 0,5,6,6; the exact signed 1x2 Morse differential is identically zero. The six-cell degree map to S5 is therefore null by π5(S5)=Z, establishing S5∨S6∨S6. Full mod-two boundary ranks and rational top-cycle symmetry plus signed Lefschetz provide independent computation paths within the supplied verifier. All computations are finite and fully regenerated from attached source and certified data.

value.rationale: B(2,3) is the canonical first nontrivial order-three binary shift-register directed network. The exact nonpure mixed-dimensional homotopy decomposition and bit-complement eigenspaces characterize the whole directed forest space rather than only spanning arborescence counts. This small structural finite classification gives a natural reference invariant for directed-complex topology beyond acyclic and fully bidirected families; no broad theorem or speculative application is required.
